items.text: The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended.
A Muslim is the one who avoids harming Muslims with his tongue and hands.
None of you will have faith till he wishes for his (Muslim) brother what he likes for himself.
Facilitate things to people (concerning religious matters), and do not make it hard for them and give them good tidings and do not make them run away (from Islam).
The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger.
Anybody who believes in Allah and the Last Day should talk what is good or keep quiet.
A man asked the Prophet ﷺ for advice. He said, “Do not become angry,” and gave the same answer each time the man asked again.
The Prophet ﷺ was asked which deeds are loved most by Allah. He said, “The most regular constant deeds even though they may be few.”
The best among you (Muslims) are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.
(Saying) a good word is also Sadaqa (charity).
Al-Wasil is not the one who recompenses the good done to him by his relatives, but Al-Wasil is the one who keeps good relations with those relatives who had severed the bond of kinship with him.
Whoever is not grateful to the people, he is not grateful to Allah.
Verily Allah does not look to your faces and your wealth but He looks to your heart and to your deeds.
He who has in his heart the weight of a mustard seed of pride shall not enter Paradise.
Feed the hungry, visit the sick, and set free the captives.
Asked which deeds in Islam are best, the Prophet ﷺ said: “To feed (the poor) and greet those whom you know and those whom you do not know.”
Save yourself from Hell-fire even by giving half a date-fruit in charity.
By Allah! I ask for forgiveness from Allah and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times a day.
Don't consider anything insignificant out of good things even if it is that you meet your brother with a cheerful countenance.
The two rak'ahs at dawn are better than this world and what it contains.
